name: [otel demo] ad service p95 latency high (${ENV_NAME})
message: p95 latency on the ad service is above 20 ms (baseline 3 to 6 ms; adHighCpu takes it to 35 to 130 ms). Evaluated on per-minute p95, the value the graphs show: p95 over shorter buckets holds only a few ad requests and kept the monitor under its threshold and flapping. The scenarios pod turns adHighCpu on from :30 to :45 each hour, UTC. Chapter 1, step 2 of the presenter script. No notification targets on purpose. On alert it starts the remediation workflow, which rolls adHighCpu back after 10 minutes: {{#is_alert}}@workflow-otel-demo-remediate-ad{{/is_alert}}
